parties: Mallcom (India) Limited and Mallcom VSFT Gloves Private Limited (wholly-owned subsidiary)
headline: Mallcom (India) Limited: NCLT Order for Scheme of Amalgamation with Wholly-Owned Subsidiary Certified Copy Received
sum: Mallcom (India) Limited has received the certified copy of the NCLT (Kolkata Bench) order approving a Scheme of Amalgamation with its wholly-owned subsidiary, Mallcom VSFT Gloves Private Limited. The filing indicates completion of NCLT approval stage for the intra-group consolidation.
implication: Receipt of certified NCLT order marks the point at which amalgamation scheme becomes final; the transferor (subsidiary) will be dissolved and its assets/liabilities vested in the transferee (Mallcom) by operation of law under the Companies Act, 2013—mandatory milestone for filing dissolutions and updating regulatory registers.
detail: Mallcom (India) Limited, a listed company in the industrial safety and protective equipment sector, has notified the NSE of receipt of the certified copy of the NCLT order in relation to a Scheme of Amalgamation (SA) between itself and its wholly-owned subsidiary, Mallcom VSFT Gloves Private Limited. The NCLT, Kolkata Bench, has approved the scheme. The receipt of certified copy marks the final stage of NCLT approval; the scheme is now ready for implementation, which typically includes filing with the Registrar of Companies, updating stock exchange filings, and formal dissolution of the subsidiary. This is an intra-group consolidation with no external stakeholder involvement, structured as a statutory merger under the Companies Act, 2013.
